strings.en: I’m super lucky. I’m always{NEWLINE}finding good items in the dirt piles{CLEAR}the archaeology team digs up.{CLEAR}If you like, I can sell you some.{SCROLL}Here’s today’s item. Want to buy it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不买了
strings.en: Nothing, thanks

strings.en: There you go! Take good{NEWLINE}care of this precious item.

strings.en: I live here! If you like, you can live{NEWLINE}here too. There’s plenty of free space.

strings.zh: 前面是还没有深入研究的{NEWLINE}阿鲁夫遗迹石室,{CLEAR}在失踪的秀力博士回来之前,{CLEAR}禁止任何游客前往石室。
strings.en: Ahead are chambers of{NEWLINE}the Ruins of Alph that haven’t been{CLEAR}fully studied yet. Until the missing{CLEAR}Professor Hale returns, no visitors{CLEAR}are allowed into the chambers.

strings.zh: 你也是听了关于连接洞穴的歌谣,{NEWLINE}所以来这里寻找传说中精灵的吗？
strings.en: Did you hear the rhyme about{NEWLINE}Union Cave too, and come looking{CLEAR}for the legendary Pokémon?

strings.zh: 唉？没有听过关于传说的歌谣吗？{NEWLINE}我记得在连接洞穴里听谁唱过来着。
strings.en: Huh? You haven’t heard the rhyme{NEWLINE}about the legend? I’m sure I heard{CLEAR}somebody here in Union Cave singing it.

strings.zh: 这首歌谣的歌词好像是在描述{NEWLINE}唤醒传说中精灵的方法。{CLEAR}但是根据我的研究,{CLEAR}只有方法是不够的,{CLEAR}必须要在特定的日子{CLEAR}使用这个方法才能奏效。
strings.en: The words of the rhyme seem to describe{NEWLINE}how to awaken the legendary Pokémon.{SCROLL}But from my research, the method{NEWLINE}alone isn’t enough. It only works{CLEAR}if you use it on a particular day.

strings.zh: 我为了寻找传说中的精灵,{NEWLINE}在连接洞穴里待了不知道多久,{CLEAR}连外面的日期都忘了。{CLEAR}你能告诉我今天是星期几吗？
strings.en: I’ve been in Union Cave searching{NEWLINE}for the legendary Pokémon for{CLEAR}who knows how long. I’ve even lost{CLEAR}track of the date outside. Can you{CLEAR}tell me what day of the week it is?

strings.zh: 星期一
strings.en: Monday

strings.zh: 星期二
strings.en: Tuesday

strings.zh: 星期三
strings.en: Wednesday

strings.zh: 星期四
strings.en: Thursday

strings.zh: 星期五
strings.en: Friday

strings.zh: 星期六
strings.en: Saturday

strings.zh: 星期天
strings.en: Sunday

strings.zh: 哦,今天是日耀日的星期天啊,{NEWLINE}不知道我何时才能找到传说中的精灵{CLEAR}然后去外面享受周末的时光。
strings.en: Oh, so today is Sunday, the day of{NEWLINE}the sun. I wonder when I’ll find{CLEAR}the legendary Pokémon and get{CLEAR}to go out and enjoy the weekend.
strings.notes: Weekday lines follow the Japanese-style day names in the zh (日/月/火/水/木/金/土耀日): sun, moon, fire, water, wood, metal, earth.

strings.zh: 哦,今天是月耀日的星期一啊,{NEWLINE}又是一周的开始,{CLEAR}我要打起精神来寻找传说中的精灵。
strings.en: Oh, so today is Monday, the day of{NEWLINE}the moon. Another week begins. I’d{CLEAR}better pull myself together and keep{CLEAR}searching for the legendary Pokémon.

strings.zh: 哦,今天是火耀日的星期二啊,{NEWLINE}地底的岩浆在这个日子里也会沸腾吧。
strings.en: Oh, so today is Tuesday, the day of{NEWLINE}fire. I bet the magma underground{CLEAR}boils on a day like this.
strings.notes: Heatran hint: the rhyme (0085 #99) plus the right day (Tuesday, fire).

strings.zh: 哦,今天是水耀日的星期三啊,{NEWLINE}今天全国各地是不是都在下雨啊。
strings.en: Oh, so today is Wednesday, the day{NEWLINE}of water. I wonder if it’s raining{CLEAR}all over the country today.

strings.zh: 哦,今天是木耀日的星期四啊,{NEWLINE}我听说桐树林在这个日子里,{CLEAR}会有罕见的精灵出现。
strings.en: Oh, so today is Thursday, the day{NEWLINE}of wood. I heard rare Pokémon{CLEAR}appear in Ilex Forest on this day.

strings.zh: 哦,今天是金耀日的星期五啊,{NEWLINE}钢系的精灵在今天会特别活跃吗？
strings.en: Oh, so today is Friday, the day{NEWLINE}of metal. I wonder if Steel-type{CLEAR}Pokémon are extra lively today.

strings.zh: 哦,今天是土耀日的星期六啊,{NEWLINE}连接洞穴不会突发地震{CLEAR}把我们给埋了吧。
strings.en: Oh, so today is Saturday, the day of{NEWLINE}earth. I hope Union Cave doesn’t have{CLEAR}a sudden earthquake and bury us all.

strings.zh: 你走到这里已经很疲惫了吧,{NEWLINE}需要我用超能力为你治疗吗？{CLEAR}一次只要500块哦。
strings.en: You must be worn out after coming{NEWLINE}all this way. Want me to heal you with{CLEAR}my psychic powers? Just $500 a time!

strings.zh: 你的钱不够治疗费用,{NEWLINE}我可不会免费帮你。
strings.en: You don’t have enough money for the{NEWLINE}treatment. I’m not doing it for free.

strings.zh: 看我的超能力！
strings.en: Behold my psychic powers!

strings.zh: 一股神秘的热气袭来！
strings.en: A mysterious wave of{NEWLINE}heat rushes at you!

strings.zh: 神秘的热气被清净符驱散了。
strings.en: The mysterious heat was{NEWLINE}driven off by the Cleanse Tag.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,前面有神奇的热气{NEWLINE}会阻挡你的去路,{CLEAR}只有老身给你带路,{CLEAR}才能驱散热气通过那里。{SCROLL}你愿意花2000元{NEWLINE}雇老身带你通过前面的路吗？
strings.en: Heh heh. Up ahead, a strange heat{NEWLINE}will block your path. Only if this{CLEAR}old woman leads the way can the{CLEAR}heat be driven off so you can pass.{SCROLL}Will you hire this old woman for{NEWLINE}$2000 to take you through?

strings.zh: 你身上剩的钱可不够我做法发功啊。
strings.en: You don’t have enough money{NEWLINE}left for me to work my magic.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,来吧,老身为你引路。
strings.en: Heh heh, come along. This{NEWLINE}old woman will lead the way.

strings.zh: 天灵灵、地灵灵,热气先不要显灵！
strings.en: Spirits of heaven, spirits of earth,{NEWLINE}heat, don’t you show your face!

strings.zh: 嘿！热气退散！
strings.en: Hah! Heat, begone!

strings.zh: 你可以放心通过前面了,{NEWLINE}这一次热气不会再出现了。{CLEAR}不过也仅限这一次,{CLEAR}下次你如果还想通过这里的话,{CLEAR}就再来找我吧。
strings.en: You can pass through safely now.{NEWLINE}The heat won’t come back this time.{SCROLL}But only this time. If you{NEWLINE}want to pass through here{CLEAR}again, come and find me again.

strings.zh: 这里是熔岩池的中心。
strings.en: This is the center of the lava pool.

strings.zh: 背包里的火山镇石似乎在发热,{NEWLINE}要把火山镇石放到台子上吗？
strings.en: The Magma Stone in your{NEWLINE}Bag seems to be heating up. Place{CLEAR}the Magma Stone on the pedestal?

strings.zh: 席多蓝恩『Cyyy——！{SCROLL}熔岩中的精灵席多蓝恩出现了！{NEWLINE}要尝试捕捉它吗？
strings.en: Heatran: Cyyy--!{SCROLL}Heatran, the Pokémon of the{NEWLINE}lava, appeared! Try to catch it?

strings.zh: 金铃铛『Gooo——rin！
strings.en: Chingling: Gooo-rin!

strings.zh: 因为秀力博士的归来,{NEWLINE}遗迹的研究终于可以继续推动了。
strings.en: Now that Professor Hale is{NEWLINE}back, research on the ruins{CLEAR}can finally move forward.
